The chain rule states that after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B.

Starting from (vay, ujy), the first item of ujy is vay. So the next pair in the chain is the one whose first item is vay.

The first item of ujy is jkl. So the next pair in the chain is the one whose first item is jkl.

The first item of jkl is klm. So the next pair in the chain is the one whose first item is klm.
